Join the official WhatsApp group for participation details, announcements and important hackathon updates.

A participant must complete the hackathon and make a valid final submission to receive a verifiable digital certificate. Registration alone will not qualify a participant for a certificate.

PPOs and partner benefits are subject to eligibility requirements, availability and the respective partner’s selection process.

Rules

  • Participants must submit original work within the deadline and follow all event guidelines.
  • Plagiarism, false information or multiple submissions may result in disqualification.

Eligibility

  • Open to students, developers, designers and technology enthusiasts across India.
  • Participants may join individually or form a team according to the event’s permitted team size.

Process

  • Register for the event, join the official communication group and complete every announced round.
  • Qualified participants will receive the instructions and submission details for the next stage.

 

Note: Teams selected for Round 3 pay a participation fee of ₹399 per team — one payment for the whole team, not one each. The fee covers the cost of running the event: infrastructure, the time and effort of organising it, and paying the people who do that work. Registering and Rounds 1 and 2 are free, and this is the only payment anywhere in this event. It falls due only once your team is selected for Round 3, so a team that is not selected pays nothing at all.
